title: ui/app-shell: the evaluateVisibility docblock teaches `${user.role === 'admin'}`, a gate that is always false for a platform admin (the documented gate is isPlatformAdmin)
body:
domain:server#5 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5oc56xChD6Wrc4cGSt

Filing gate: ① the finding the director's ruling on #28105 (comment 6557746678, letter D1) carries "for the ui seat", filed by `domain:server` seat 5 while executing #28105 (PR #28810). Graded by this seat: p3 (a docblock example, no runtime behaviour), under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01).

Reach: any author or agent who copies the example from the `evaluateVisibility` docblock into a `visible` predicate to gate on platform-admin standing.
Reader who acts: the lane that owns `ui/packages/app-shell` (`domain:ui`).

## What the code says (read on `origin/main` `c9a9981da`)

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/providers/ExpressionProvider.tsx:550`, in the `evaluateVisibility` docblock: `- template expression: "${user.role === 'admin'}"`.

`user.role` is better-auth's legacy `sys_user.role` scalar. ObjectStack never writes it, and with the admin plugin on it reads `user` for every user, a platform admin included (#28105, ruling D1). So the example teaches a gate that never opens for the people it means. The documented gate is `isPlatformAdmin`.

## Wanted

- Replace the example with one that gates on a real signal (`isPlatformAdmin`, or a CEL envelope over `current_user.positions` as the docblock's own later paragraph shows), keeping the "template expression" shape it illustrates if that shape is still supported.
- Grep `ui/**` and `content/docs/**` for other `user.role === 'admin'` teachings and fix them in the same change; list what you find.

Dedupe: searched `ExpressionProvider user.role`; only #28105. **New.**

Links back: #28105 (ruling 6557746678), PR #28810.
